answer: Stop sybils with a willow braid on a river delta. Each identity weaves one willow strand into a braid with unrelated peers, and influence flows only along paths from the river source to the sea, one path per vertex. A vertex shared by two paths merges both identities into one standing and slashes each bond by the merged count, so N clones from one funder pay roughly N squared in bonds for one share. The delta admits few new braids per epoch, so clones queue while one honest agent crosses at once.
